title: Measure rider sag

applicability.included: Exact standard US 2020 Yamaha YZ250F with original stock suspension.
excluded: Other years, modified valving, replacement shock/fork assemblies or springs

entry_state: Assembled bike with identified original components and serviceable suspension.
exit_state: Rider sag measured and assessed; preload rings, rear frame and springs remain unchanged.
preflight: Use the exact-year diagrams to identify the adjusters and measurement points.
Record current setup before changing it; do not force an adjuster past its stop.
critical_stop_conditions: Unidentified component or adjuster; leaks, damage or binding; target setting cannot be reached within actual travel.

source.review_note: Root independent review approved exact-year settings and diagrams; assembled preload access prerequisite preserved. Physical validation remains outstanding.

steps.title: Prepare the measurement
steps.instruction: Check the shock for leaks and verify smooth suspension/linkage movement. Use level ground and a helper to stabilize the bike and take consistent readings.
verification: Save the actual measurements or setting and outcome.

steps.title: Measure the unloaded bike
steps.instruction: Support the bike under the engine so the rear wheel is off the floor. Measure A from the rear axle center to the rear-fender holding bolt. Use the illustrated points and record the actual millimeters.
verification: Save the actual measurements or setting and outcome.

steps.title: Measure with the rider
steps.instruction: Remove the stand and have the rider sit astride the seat as shown. With the bike held upright, measure B between the same axle center and the rear-fender holding bolt. Record the actual millimeters.
verification: Save the actual measurements or setting and outcome.

steps.title: Calculate rider sag
steps.instruction: Subtract B from A. The standard difference is 90–100 mm. Record both measurements, the difference and whether it is in range.
verification: Save the actual measurements or setting and outcome.

steps.title: Save the result
steps.instruction: Dismount and support the bike securely. Save the result and any needed follow-up. This operation measures sag only. Preload adjustment on this year requires rear-frame removal/refitting; arrange that complete service before altering the rings. Do not mark an out-of-range reading as an adjusted setup.
verification: Save the actual measurements or setting and outcome.

completeness: Rider sag measured and assessed; preload rings, rear frame and springs remain unchanged.
